title: Testing syntax errors inside expressions
description: Once the expression ladder is complete, test_bad_operator and test_mismatched_paren verify that broken expressions fail at the offending token.

steps.description: test_bad_operator passes 'let x = 5 + * 3;' to parse_error, where a second operator * appears right after + where a primary expression belongs.

steps.question: After the parser consumes '+' in 'let x = 5 + * 3;', which token does the bottom of the expression ladder see when it looks for the right-hand operand?
steps.answer: It sees STAR ('*') at line 1, column 13 instead of a primary expression.

steps.description: Lines 4 and 5 assert that the error message reports 'expected an expression, found STAR' at line 1, column 13.
test_mismatched_paren parses 'print (1 + 2;' and checks that the parenthesized expression reports 'expected RPAREN, found SEMICOLON'.
Both test functions are defined and ready for the test runner to execute.
